notes.title: 🎮ZOMVIRUS Metastore Release Preparation News
notes.notes:
Hello, fellow survivors!

This is the ZOMVIRUS development team.



Thanks to your enthusiastic interest and valuable feedback, we're excited to be making final preparations for ZOMVIRUS's official Metastore release.


[hr][/hr]🔧Standalone Environment Optimization in Progress
We're currently conducting final checks and optimizations to ensure the game runs reliably in a standalone environment.

We're also preparing to allow players to play ZOMVIRUS freely, anytime, anywhere, using only their MetaQuest device, without a PC.



More players will soon be able to experience the thrilling survival action of ZOMVIRUS through the Metastore.

We look forward to seeing what ZOMVIRUS, enjoyable anytime, anywhere, will look like on the Metastore.


[hr][/hr]🚀Major Update in Preparation for Release
With the Metastore launch, we're also working on various improvements to provide a more complete gaming experience.

📌Graphics and performance optimization

📌Zombie variety diversification and several map structural reorganizations

📌Improved control convenience and overall stability



We are currently developing the overall gameplay environment, focusing particularly on maximizing immersion in the VR environment.


[hr][/hr]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45267902/76525878872cfe4a2711d78f00bdce287253d689.png"]

🧟‍♂️Survival, but more than that, suspense

ZOMVIRUS goes beyond a simple zombie shooter; we aim to convey the true joy of survival through the intuitive controls and immersion unique to VR.

Unpredictable threats, survival determined by a single bullet, and intense combat where moment-to-moment decisions can change the course of the game.

All of this unfolds in real time at your fingertips.



Are you ready to unleash your survival instincts?

Experience Hongdae, Seoul in person with ZOMVIRUS.



We look forward to your continued support.

Thank you.

— The Dream of the ZOMVIRUS Development Team

notes.title: 🔧 [ZOMVIRUS Update News] Standard Gun Control System! 🔧
notes.notes:
Hello, fellow survivors.

This is the ZOMVIRUS development team.



Today, we're announcing major overhauls to the gun control system, which has been a long-standing topic of user feedback.

As this is an element that determines the feel and immersion of combat, we've meticulously reviewed each aspect based on your feedback.

We're currently working on a major overhaul to ensure a more immersive and stable combat experience in the VR environment.


[hr][/hr]


1. Improved Gun Control Sensitivity and Shake

One of the most frequently reported issues we've received is feedback like, "My hands shake even when I'm quiet, making it difficult to aim," and "When I add a gun, it becomes too much fun and breaks the immersion."



Issue:

- Previously, unnecessary shaking of the hand and gun even when standing still made aiming difficult and inconvenient.



Solution:

- This revision improves hand position stability, ensuring the gun remains naturally stable even when standing still.

- We've reduced unnecessary gun shaking in VR environments, allowing for smoother, more precise firing.


[hr][/hr]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45267902/ccdb56c0f7c353af6a15c47c967c0bf673934cc3.gif"]

2. Improved Gun Grab System Flexibility

We received feedback that the previous system felt unnatural, with players experiencing awkward gripping of the gun, their hands flicking when gripping it with both hands, and inaccurate loading.

The following improvements have been made to provide a more natural and flexible control experience.



Improvements:

- The grab points have been completely redesigned to more intuitively grasp various parts of the gun, including the handle, magazine, and slide.

- We've reduced the apparent stuttering when firing with both hands, allowing for a smoother grip.

- Improved magazine ejection and reloading methods have enhanced the physical response when grabbing and reloading the magazine, providing a more realistic feel for the actual weapon.


[hr][/hr]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45267902/d3a786b9e9181bc8116ca5bf2cfcca5581f7998a.gif"]

3. Firearm Recoil Renewal

We received feedback that the recoil felt too strong or unnatural when firing firearms, resulting in a lackluster shooting experience.

In response to this feedback, we have adjusted the recoil values and recoil animations for all weapons to be more realistic.



Improvements:

- We are currently applying recoil that matches the unique characteristics of each weapon, such as pistols and rifles.

- We have improved the reaction time and position return speed of the hand recoil after firing, providing a more realistic impact feel.


[hr][/hr]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45267902/f4e11dd95dc948ca2894c6fb5e225388d90cc50d.gif"]

4. Planned Introduction of Two-Handed Pistol Grab Feature

- Currently a feature in internal testing, we plan to officially introduce two-handed pistol grab functionality in the next update.

- We are currently in the final testing phase and will be introducing it soon in an update.



At ZOMVIRUS, your feedback is of the utmost importance to us.

We will continue to make steady improvements to further enhance the immersion and realism of gameplay.

Please report any bugs or suggest improvements through the official Discord or Steam message boards.



Thank you.

The Dream of the ZOMVIRUS Development Team

notes.title: 'ZOMVIRUS ' Official release
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone! This is the ZOMVIRUS team.
It’s been a while since we last reached out!

During the Early Access period, we went through various trials and errors, reflecting on feedback and making improvements. After a long journey, we are finally here with exciting news.

Today, we bring you updates regarding the official release of ZOMVIRUS and changes to the game.

① Changes to the Gameplay
Before: The game followed an open-world-like progression.

Players moved through different areas, searching for safe zones and clearing stages upon reaching the destination.
When moving to a new area, zombies and weapons would reset.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45267902/7458dd59b3ad438b36d7804678c4b5c04753aac4.png

After: The game now follows a stage-based progression.

The Hongdae district has been divided into different zones, where players must clear each stage.
Clearing a stage creates a separate area for players to rest and prepare.
Once a gun is obtained, it can be used continuously.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45267902/6c2e2be69f22a8582eeffec3384e46e22c15eadf.png

② Strengthening the Game's Narrative
Before: Aside from being set in a Korean zombie apocalypse, the story lacked depth.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45267902/8531e74e8a1577780934964387c44e304a3c2d06.png

After: The tutorial has been revised to enhance the coherence of the storyline.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45267902/028581db9a96099a68020cac22dd68893894dcd5.png

③ New Areas & Zombies Added
New Area (Hapjeong Station, Line 2): A new zone inside Hapjeong Station has been added for gameplay
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45267902/a7420d266f9f8537040fe5493ffab7cde1066566.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45267902/ef07308b52a066e9b9f9039ff66022fba8871209.png

New Zombies: The "Tattooed Pig Zombie" and a "Large Zombie" have been introduced.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45267902/4a2394e1dfbf3851f068dab959ea4522ce424c93.png

④ Renewal of Hongdae Street Background
Some parts of Hongdae Street have been modified.

1) Sidewalk remodeling
Before: Some sidewalks were awkwardly designed.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45267902/8a6e518e6daf990976c77a28e4d5d45c3b710efa.png
After: Sidewalk slopes have been improved.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45267902/6c10d51207011632cd00bb909926de01b154a89b.png

2)Changes to the Hongdae street map structure
Before: The streets felt empty and lacked structures.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45267902/1b019c1d7382b44e8e92c442c641eb29bac6073e.png
After: The environment has been modified to fit the apocalyptic concept.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45267902/6c10d51207011632cd00bb909926de01b154a89b.png

⑤ Other Changes
Reduced difficulty in obtaining weapons
Reduced difficulty in obtaining consumables
UI improvements
Game optimization updates
Beyond these updates, you can now experience the new and improved ZOMVIRUS in the game!

Our ZOMVIRUS team is always eager to hear from our "Survivors."

If you have any feedback regarding survival challenges, supplies, or shelter, please let us know.

We will continue to strive to create a fun and engaging game experience.

Thank you!
